## Lumentum named to TIME’s 2027 America’s Top Manufacturers


November 23, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/377324469/files/doc_news/Lumentum-named-to-TIMEs-2027-Americas-Top-Manufacturers-2026.pdf)


**SAN JOSE, Calif., November 23, 2026** - Lumentum Holdings Inc. (“Lumentum”) today announced its inclusion on TIME and Statista’s *America’s Top Manufacturers 2027* list. The ranking recognizes the top 250 U.S. manufacturers evaluated across three areas: financial performance, innovation capacity, and employee satisfaction, using company disclosures, public databases, patent analytics, and workplace data.


The recognition reflects Lumentum’s focus on delivering strong business performance, advancing photonics innovation, and supporting the talented people and capabilities behind its manufacturing operations.


“We’re proud to be included among the best manufacturers in America,” said Michael Hurlston, Chief Executive Officer at Lumentum. “Demand for optical technologies is rising, and we are investing to expand critical U.S. manufacturing capacity, from San Jose, CA to Greensboro, NC. In addition to state-of-the-art facilities and equipment, it takes skilled people to ensure consistent quality and reliability of our products. This recognition honors the teams whose work is strengthening American manufacturing.”


Earlier this year, Lumentum announced a new 240,000-square-foot facility in Greensboro, North Carolina, to manufacture indium phosphide (InP) optical devices for AI data centers. The investment will increase U.S. manufacturing capabilities while providing more than 400 jobs. Combined with the San Jose expansion, it will strengthen domestic supply chain resilience and help Lumentum support the growing needs of cloud and AI infrastructure customers.


Explore career opportunities[here](https://lumentum.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/LITE) .


**About Lumentum**


Lumentum (NASDAQ: LITE) is a global leader in optical and photonic technologies that power the networks and infrastructure behind AI, cloud computing, and next-generation communications. Built on decades of photonics innovation, Lumentum delivers high-performance lasers, modules, and optical subsystems that enable scalable, energy-efficient data center connectivity, advanced telecom networks, industrial manufacturing, and sensing applications. Headquartered in San Jose, California, the company operates R&D, manufacturing, and sales facilities worldwide.
